segments.text:
V. 39.
Therefore now they could not believe—That is, by the juſt Judgment of GOD, for their Obſtinacy and wilful Reſiſtance of the Truth, they were at length ſo left to the Hardneſs of their Hearts, that neither the Miracles nor Doctrine of our LORD, could make any Impreſſion upon them.
